repo.description:
### Impact

The AWS SES bounce webhook (POST /webhooks/aws) verifies that an SNS message is signed by Amazon, but not that it came from a trusted SNS topic (no TopicArn allowlist). Any AWS account holder can create their own SNS topic, subscribe a target's webhook URL to it, and publish validly-signed but forged SES "Bounce" notifications for any email address. Two forged permanent bounces (defaults: hard_bounce_score = 2, bounce_score_threshold = 4) revoke the targeted user's email, so Discourse stops sending them notifications and password-reset / login emails. The attack needs no forum account and no victim interaction.

Sites that expose the email webhooks endpoint and use AWS SES + SNS for bounces are impacted.

###  Patches

A new site setting `allowed_aws_sns_topic_arns` is added so the subscription-confirmation and notification jobs now reject any SNS message whose TopicArn isn't on the allowlist.

### Workarounds

Don't use AWS SES/SNS. Alternatively block POST `/webhooks/aws` at your reverse proxy (or leave the email-webhooks feature disabled).
repo.summary: Forged AWS SNS bounce notifications can disable a targeted user's email (missing TopicArn binding)
